post.caption:
CFCs from fridges and sprays were destroying the ozone layer, and the hole has been shrinking since about 2000. The honest reason it worked: there were cheap substitutes and only a small number of manufacturers, so a worldwide ban was actually enforceable. Not every problem looks like that one.
